## Exercise 1: Practicing ggplot
1. Create a scatterplot showing insect abundance over time.
    - Map date to x and abundance to y.
    - Add points and a smoothed trendline.
    - Experiment with point color, size, and transparency.
2. Compare abundance across habitat types.
    - Create a boxplot or violin plot.
    - Map habitat to the x-axis and abundance to the y-axis.
    - Use fill to distinguish habitat types.
    - Try at least two different discrete color scales.
3. Explore the relationship between temperature and insect abundance.
    - Create a scatterplot.
    - Map temperature to x and abundance to y.
    - Map habitat to color or shape.
    - Add a smooth trendline.
4. Customize one of your plots.
    - Add a title, subtitle, axis labels, and caption.
    - Adjust axis breaks and labels.
    - Apply a built-in theme or create a custom theme.
